FAIL_TO_PASS: include-namespace-reexport-path: includes paths across namespace reeports
optional-chaining-namespace: supports optional chaining with namespace objects
namespace-import: warns when a conflicting binding is imported via a namespace import
namespace-missing-export: replaces missing namespace members with undefined and warns about them
warning-incorrect-sourcemap-location: does not fail if a warning has an incorrect location due to missing sourcemaps
namespace-reassign-import-fails: warns for reassignments to namespace exports
warn-import-export: warns about import and export related issues
namespace-optimization: it does static lookup optimization of internal namespaces
preserve-exported-object-in-namespace: preserve the exported object that imported by namespace
